description.summary: You raise a corpse into a fiercesome Grave Knight
description.value: You raise a corpse into a fiercesome Grave Knight. Any corpse with a hit dice less than your caster level raises into a Grave Knight. The undead creature retains all of its class features, feats, skills, and stats that it had in life and adds the Grave Knight template. The caster can cast this spell in 2 ways. The first way: It can be cast a swift action, but casts at touch range and only lasts 1 round per level. The second way: It can be cast as a full-round action, but casts at close range and lasts 1 minute per level. Once a corpse has been affected by this spell or this Raise Undead spell, it can no longer be affected. The undead created by this spell obeys your commands to the best of their ability and does not normally try to attack you.
